cohort: 200 pregnant women with term singleton pregnancies and a Bishop's score of 4 or less.
finding: Dinoprostone gel is more effective for cervical ripening and shortening the induction-to-delivery time but is associated with higher rates of uterine hyperstimulation, whereas the Foley catheter is safer with fewer systemic side effects.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery rates were higher in the dinoprostone group (76%) compared to the Foley catheter group (62%).
